## Description and Rationale

I am a solo team, an aerospace engineer (7 years in flight operations consulting and flight performance engineering) currently transitioning into applied machine learning. I am entering this challenge to apply ML to a real operational aviation problem and build a hands-on portfolio project. Taxi-out time prediction sits right at the intersection of my aviation domain background and my current ML learning path.
